title: On a phone: reference files, outstanding work and the back button
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A phone; an inspection with a reference file attached and required fields left unanswered.
custom_steps:
1. Open a reference file and confirm it opens across the full screen in the same view and closes back to the exact position in the inspection.
2. Confirm outstanding required work is surfaced on the action that completes the section, carrying a count, rather than as a separate competing banner.
3. Select an outstanding item and confirm it moves to the first field that still needs an answer, not to a summary of what is missing.
4. Confirm the layout does not draw its own back control where the device already provides one.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A reference file opens across the full screen, in the same view, and closes back to the exact position in the inspection.
  • Outstanding required work is surfaced on the action that completes the section, carrying a count, rather than as a separate banner competing with the fields.
  • Selecting an outstanding item moves to the first field that still needs an answer, rather than to a summary of what is missing.
  • The layout does not draw its own back control where the device already provides one.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9397 (S14 — Inspection filling on a phone); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S14; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-R5: “A reference file will open across the full screen, in the same view, and will be closable back to the exact position in the inspection”
  • S14-R6: “Outstanding required work will be surfaced on the action that completes the section, carrying a count, rather than as a separate banner competing with the fields”
  • S14-R7: “Selecting an outstanding item will move to the first field that still needs an answer, rather than to a summary of what is missing”
  • S14-R8: “The layout will not draw its own back control where the device already provides one”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
